`astronaut.png`: public-domain NASA photograph distributed by scikit-image, used only to test local face landmark placement. Source: https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/blob/v0.19.3/skimage/data/astronaut.png . Dataset documentation: https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut . This fixture is not bundled in the app, used for identity recognition, or uploaded to a paid API during tests.
